workspace.basis: Kickoff field dimensions; reference target box only. Exact field mesh and target are used in the scoring simulation.

world.axes: x downfield, y across field, z up

robot.basis: First saved robot pose in continuous-cycle-96

target.basis: Approximate speaker reference. Official opening geometry governs the field trial.

narratives.title: Recover, score, climb
narratives.narrative: Acquire finite floor NOTES, deliver to the speaker, then park or climb.

requirements.outcome: Move the retained NOTE out of the cassette
requirements.screen: Registered free-piece trajectory, launch exit and paired field detections.

unresolvedChecks: Verify floor clearance and roller pickup with the solid front perimeter.

programming.pseudocode: Confirm retention, aim and feed. Observe exit, clear the cassette and reset.

openQuestions: Measure NOTE load versus indentation and tangential force under slip.

provenance.basis: Guided cassette 1.0. The editable envelope is secondary to the registered solid model and the pinned trial traces.
limitations: Reference target and route speeds in the envelope editor are approximate. Use the retained field trajectory for scoring.
